info.name: HR Service API
info.description:
HR system: departments, employees, performance reviews, work schedules, office attendance, payroll and leaves (Go gRPC service behind Envoy gRPC-JSON transcoding).

Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or newman). The first request prepares the run (unique names, dates relative to today) and every request stores the ids it creates in collection variables. Set `baseUrl` if the API is not on http://localhost:8080.

item.name: 1. Departments
item.description: CRUD for departments. PUT replaces every field, PATCH changes only the fields that are sent.

request.description:
`name` is required and unique (409). Returns **201 Created**.

The pre-request script of this request prepares the variables used by the whole run.

exec: // ---- run setup: unique suffix + dates relative to today ----
// a Monday at least a week ago, and the Tuesday after it
// previous month and the month before it (payroll periods must not be in the future)
const plus = (days) => { const d = new Date(now); d.setDate(d.getDate() + days); return iso(d); };
pm.test("no employees yet", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.employee_count === 0 && b.average_salary === 0).to.be.true; });

request.description: `q` = case-insensitive name search; `limit` 1..100 (default 20); `offset` >= 0.

exec: pm.test("both departments of this run", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total === 2 && b.departments.length === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("right department", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('deptId')).to.be.true; });

request.description: Full replace: omitted fields become empty.

exec: pm.test("location replaced", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.location.endsWith('floor 6')).to.be.true; });

request.description: Partial update: only `description` changes.

exec: pm.test("description changed", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.description === 'Product engineering').to.be.true; });
pm.test("location kept", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.location.endsWith('floor 6')).to.be.true; });

item.name: 2. Work schedules
item.description: Schedule templates assigned to employees; they define working days and when a check-in is late.

request.description: `work_days`: ISO weekdays (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday). A check-in later than `start_time + late_grace_minutes` is late. Returns **201 Created**.

exec: pm.test("45 hours per week", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.hours_per_week === 45).to.be.true; });

request.description: Duplicate days are ignored and days are sorted.

exec: pm.test("days normalised", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(b.work_days) === '[6,7]').to.be.true; });
pm.test("contains created schedule", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.schedules.some(s => s.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('scheduleId'))).to.be.true; });
pm.test("right schedule", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('scheduleId')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("grace changed", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.late_grace_minutes === 15).to.be.true; });

item.name: 3. Employees
item.description: Employees belong to one department (one-to-many) and optionally follow a work schedule (one-to-many).

request.description: Required: `department_id` (must exist), `first_name`, `last_name`, `email` (unique, lower-cased). `hire_date` defaults to today, `status` to ACTIVE. Returns **201 Created** with the department and schedule embedded.

exec: pm.test("email normalised", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.email === b.email.toLowerCase()).to.be.true; });
pm.test("phone normalised", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.phone === '+77015551234').to.be.true; });
pm.test("department embedded", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.department.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('deptId')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("schedule embedded", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.schedule.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('scheduleId')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("ACTIVE by default", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status === 'ACTIVE').to.be.true; });

request.description: No schedule: Monday-Friday count as working days and lateness is not tracked.

exec: pm.test("no schedule", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.schedule_id === '').to.be.true; });

request.description: Filters: `q` (name, email or position), `department_id`, `status`, plus `limit` / `offset`.

exec: pm.test("two employees in Engineering", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("right employee", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('empId')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("full_name", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.full_name === 'Aigerim Sadykova').to.be.true; });

request.description: Full replace of all writable fields.

exec: pm.test("position replaced", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.position === 'Senior backend developer').to.be.true; });

request.description: Partial update: only `salary` changes. `schedule_id: ""` would remove the schedule.

exec: pm.test("salary changed", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.salary === 950000).to.be.true; });
pm.test("position kept", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.position === 'Senior backend developer').to.be.true; });

request.description: Related data (one-to-many). Optional `status`, `limit`, `offset`. 404 for an unknown department.

exec: pm.test("two employees", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("all in this department", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.employees.every(e => e.department_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('deptId'))).to.be.true; });

request.description: Related data (one-to-many): who works on this schedule.

exec: pm.test("only the developer", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total === 1 && b.employees[0].id === pm.collectionVariables.get('empId')).to.be.true; });

item.name: Department shows headcount and average salary

exec: pm.test("2 employees, average (950000 + 1200000) / 2", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.employee_count === 2 && b.average_salary === 1075000).to.be.true; });

item.name: 4. Performance reviews
item.description: One review per employee per quarter, score 1..5. The reviewer is another employee.

request.description: `period` like `2026-Q3` (normalised to upper case), `score` 1..5, `reviewer_id` optional (must exist, cannot be the employee). `review_date` defaults to today and must not be in the future. Returns **201 Created**.

body.raw:
{
  "reviewer_id": "{{managerId}}",
  "period": "2026-q3",
  "score": 4,
  "comment": "Delivered the payroll module on time.",
  "goals": "Mentor a junior developer",
  "review_date": "{{lastMonday}}"
}

exec: pm.test("period normalised", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.period === '2026-Q3').to.be.true; });
pm.test("reviewer embedded", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.reviewer.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('managerId')).to.be.true; });

request.description: Related data (one-to-many), newest period first, with `average_score`.

exec: pm.test("2 reviews, average 4.5", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total === 2 && b.average_score === 4.5).to.be.true; });
pm.test("newest first", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.reviews[0].period === '2026-Q3').to.be.true; });
pm.test("right review", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('reviewId')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("score changed", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.score === 5).to.be.true; });

item.name: 5. Office attendance
item.description: One record per employee per day. Lateness is calculated from the work schedule when the record is created.

request.description: Manual record for a past day (HR correction). Schedule 09:00 + 15 min grace, arrived 09:25, so the employee is 25 minutes late. Returns **201 Created**.

exec: pm.test("25 minutes late", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.is_late && b.late_minutes === 25).to.be.true; });
pm.test("8h45m worked", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.worked_minutes === 525).to.be.true; });

request.description: 09:10 is within the 15 minute grace period, so it is not late.

exec: pm.test("not late", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(!b.is_late && b.late_minutes === 0).to.be.true; });

request.description: Marks that the employee came to the office now (today, server time zone). Returns **201 Created**.

exec: pm.test("no check-out yet", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.check_out === '' && b.worked_minutes === 0).to.be.true; });
pm.test("same record", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('checkInId')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("check_out set", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.check_out !== '').to.be.true; });

request.description: Related data (one-to-many), newest first, with a summary for the whole date range.

exec: pm.test("2 days, 1 late", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total === 2 && b.summary.days_present === 2 && b.summary.days_late === 1).to.be.true; });
pm.test("worked 525 + 530 minutes", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.summary.total_worked_minutes === 1055).to.be.true; });
pm.test("25 late minutes", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.summary.total_late_minutes === 25).to.be.true; });

request.description: Who was in the office: PRESENT / LATE / ABSENT / LEAVE (approved leave) / DAY_OFF (not a working day of their schedule).

exec: pm.test("developer was late", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.entries.find(e => e.employee.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('empId')).status === 'LATE').to.be.true; });
pm.test("manager was absent", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.entries.find(e => e.employee.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('managerId')).status === 'ABSENT').to.be.true; });
pm.test("counts", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.present_count === 1 && b.late_count === 1 && b.absent_count === 1).to.be.true; });

item.name: 6. Payroll
item.description: Payslips: base + bonus - deductions = net. DRAFT can be edited, then it is PAID (final).

request.description: `period` is a month `YYYY-MM` (not in the future, one payslip per employee per month). `base_amount` defaults to the current salary. Returns **201 Created** as DRAFT.

exec: pm.test("base = salary", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.base_amount === 950000).to.be.true; });

request.description: Creates DRAFT payslips (base = salary) for every employee of the department who has none for the month yet. Returns **201** when payslips were created (200 if everyone already had one).

exec: pm.test("one new payslip (the manager)", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.created_count === 1 && b.payslip_count === 2).to.be.true; });

request.description: Totals for the month (defaults to the current month).

exec: pm.test("total net 955000 + 1200000", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total_net === 2155000).to.be.true; });
pm.test("2 drafts", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.draft_count === 2 && b.paid_count === 0).to.be.true; });

request.description: Related data (one-to-many), newest period first. Optional `status`.

exec: pm.test("one draft", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total === 1).to.be.true; });
pm.test("employee embedded", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.employee.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('empId')).to.be.true; });

request.description: Only DRAFT payslips can be changed; `net_amount` is recalculated.

exec: pm.test("net recalculated", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.net_amount === 1005000).to.be.true; });

request.description: DRAFT -> PAID, sets `paid_at`.

item.name: 7. Leaves
item.description: Vacation / sick leave / unpaid leave requests: PENDING -> APPROVED | REJECTED.

request.description: `type`: VACATION, SICK_LEAVE or UNPAID_LEAVE (case-insensitive). Dates inclusive. Overlapping PENDING/APPROVED leaves are rejected with 409. Returns **201 Created** as PENDING.

exec: pm.test("14 days", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.days === 14).to.be.true; });
pm.test("type parsed", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.type === 'SICK_LEAVE').to.be.true; });

request.description: Related data (one-to-many). Optional `status`, `limit`, `offset`.

exec: pm.test("two leaves", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total === 2).to.be.true; });

item.name: Approval queue (pending leaves of a department)

request.description: Filters: `status`, `type`, `department_id`, `limit`, `offset`.

exec: pm.test("3 pending", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total === 3 && b.leaves.every(l => l.status === 'PENDING')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("right leave", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('leaveId')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("comment saved", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.decision_comment === 'Enjoy your trip!').to.be.true; });

item.name: 8. Validation & errors
item.description: Every error has the JSON shape `{ "code": <gRPC code>, "message": "...", "details": [] }`.

exec: pm.test("message mentions: first_name is required", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("first_name is required"));
pm.test("message mentions: department_id does not reference", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("department_id does not reference"));
pm.test("message mentions: end_time must be later", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("end_time must be later"));
pm.test("message mentions: score must be between 1 and 5", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("score must be between 1 and 5"));
pm.test("message mentions: cannot review themselves", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("cannot review themselves"));
pm.test("message mentions: deductions must not exceed", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("deductions must not exceed"));
pm.test("message mentions: at least one field", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("at least one field"));
pm.test("message mentions: employee not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("employee not found"));
pm.test("message mentions: employee not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("employee not found"));
pm.test("message mentions: email already exists", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("email already exists"));

item.name: 409 - second payslip for the same month

exec: pm.test("message mentions: already has a payslip", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("already has a payslip"));

item.name: 409 - second review for the same quarter

exec: pm.test("message mentions: already has a performance review", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("already has a performance review"));

item.name: 409 - check in twice on the same day

exec: pm.test("message mentions: already checked in", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("already checked in"));
pm.test("message mentions: already checked out", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("already checked out"));

item.name: 409 - delete a department that has employees

exec: pm.test("message mentions: still has 2 employees", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("still has 2 employees"));

request.description: Setup for the next request.

item.name: 9. Deletes & cascade
item.description: DELETE endpoints return **204 No Content** with an empty body.

exec: pm.test("message mentions: paid payslips cannot be deleted", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("paid payslips cannot be deleted"));

request.description: Employees on the schedule are kept; their schedule_id becomes empty (ON DELETE SET NULL).

exec: pm.test("schedule_id cleared", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.schedule_id === '' && !b.schedule).to.be.true; });

request.description: performance_reviews.reviewer_id is ON DELETE SET NULL.

exec: pm.test("reviewer cleared", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.reviewer_id === '' && !b.reviewer).to.be.true; });

request.description: Also deletes the employee's reviews, attendance, payslips and leaves (ON DELETE CASCADE).

exec: pm.test("message mentions: department not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("department not found"));
